findings.rule: The property manager sees compliance reports of completed rounds.
findings.evidence: A chief created a future shift and scheduled a round two hours ahead, with no readings or completion. POST /q/compliance as the manager returned HTTP 200 with that round's id, status:"scheduled", scheduledAt, completedAt:null, and the nested shift id, label, startsAt and endsAt. The query has no completed-status filter, exposing metadata about uncompleted future work.
